messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend days that form the long weekend |
|---------|-------------|----------------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 (Mon) – because Jan 1 was a Sunday | Jan 1–2 (Sun‑Mon) |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7–9 (Fri‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 (Mon) – because Jul 1 was a Saturday | Jul 1–3 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 (Sat‑Mon) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some holidays (e.g., Remembrance Day, Boxing Day) fall on weekdays that don’t create a natural long weekend, so they’re omitted here.  
> • Provincial variations exist (e.g., Family Day isn’t observed in all provinces), but the table above lists the most common long weekends across Canada for 2023.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
